title: SIDESTORY: DOSSOLES HOLIDAY OPEN
lines: DETAILS: Dossoles Holiday event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, reaching milestones, and redeeming from event shop.
Event Stages will open in 3 phases:

DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Ch'en's Clue Note] missions to earn [Miss Ch'en Commemorative Medal]. It can be used to redeem rewards in [Honors Showcase] and unlock commemorative photos with hidden stages.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Tequila, Coral Coast Collection - Summer Flower FA026 for Sussurro, Stickers, LMD, Elite Materials, etc.
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Mama John's Vouchers by clearing event stages. Mama John's Vouchers can be used to redeem items from [Mama John's].
MAIN REWARDS: Tequila's Token, Dossoles Private Spa Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, LMD, Furniture Parts, Elite Materials, etc.
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Public Affairs. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Public Affairs.
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited Headhunting, "Holiday Stars", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Ch'en the Holungday [Limited] / Mizuki (70% in 6* Operators)
Operator Mizuki and Operator La Pluma will appear at Headhunting "Holiday Stars", and will be permanently added to other Headhunting in future update.
Limited Operator Ch'en the Holungday can ONLY be obtained from "Limited Headhunting: Carnival" and will NOT appear in other Standard Headhunting.
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain [Breaking Waves Headhunting Permit] * 1 as login reward.
[Breaking Waves Headhunting Permit] can only be used in Limited Headhunting "Holiday Stars."
This login reward can only be obtained once for each account.
[Breaking Waves Headhunting Permit] will be expired at January 28, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7).
DETAILS: During the event, players can sign in for 10 days to earn the following rewards.
Day 1: Customized Tea Cart * 1, Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1
Day 3: Tactical Battle Record * 10, Holiday Stand Fan * 1
Day 5: Strategic Battle Record * 5, Furniture Part * 200
Day 8: Chip Catalyst * 1, Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1
Day 10: Skill Summary - 3 * 10, Sea Breeze Fruity Shaved-Ice Cart * 1
The Top Emergency Sanity Potion from this event will expire at January 31, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7).
Players can earn all the rewards even without signing in consecutively.
05 LIMITED-TIME DAILY FREE ROLL EVENT OPEN
DETAILS: During the event, players can do one free roll in "Holiday Stars" every day.
The free roll will be refreshed at 04:00 everyday.
The unused free roll chance will be refreshed at 04:00 each day and thus cannot be accumulated.
DETAILS: The following Operators will appear at Headhunting "Holiday Stars."
Operator Tequila is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event Dossoles Holiday.
Operator Tequila is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Recruit.
Ch'en the Holungday, Mizuki, La Pluma, and Tequila will gain more trust during January 14, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – February 4, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7).

DETAILS: During the event, players can get two trials for Dossoles Amazing Wall after daily login. Between the Beating Tickets you picked, the one with the higher amount of Orundum will be the final daily reward. Players need to use all trials to get the reward.
There are 14 days at most for players to pick Beating Tickets.
Players will randomly obtain one of the following amount of Orundum from Beating Tickets:
Orundum * 200, Orundum * 300, Orundum * 400, Orundum * 500, Orundum * 600, Orundum * 800.

If the amount of Orundum in daily reward is less than 400 (400 is NOT included), players will be granted an extra trial the next day. The extra trial cannot be accumulated. Players can get 3 daily trials at most (including the extra trial).
All the daily trials will be refreshed at 04:00 on the next day and cannot be accumulated.
08 CORAL COAST COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Coral Coast Collection - Silent Night DN06 for Mudrock
Coral Coast Collection - Light Breeze LB01 for Projekt Red
Coral Coast Collection - Light Breeze LB03 for Sideroca
Coral Coast Collection - Beach Guard GT002 for Jaye
09 NEW FURNITURE SET – DOSSOLES PRIVATE SPA
DETAILS: A brand new set of themed Furniture, Dossoles Private Spa, will be available during the event.
Dossoles Holiday event rewards and redeem in Mama John's (Pieces)
The furniture pieces of this furniture set will be available at the Store from January 14, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – February 4, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7).
DETAILS: The following Operators will be permanently added to Recruitment:
When Recruitment Operators update, the Recruitment tags will be forced to refresh. Please pay attention to related update notices.
11 RHODES ISLAND 2ND ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION PACKS AVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED TIME
DETAILS: During the event, Rhodes Island 2nd Anniversary Celebration Packs will be available at Store for a limited time.
CONTENTS: Orundum * 4500, LMD * 160000, Chip Catalyst * 2, Skill Summary - 1 * 50
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 24, Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 2, LMD * 30000, Tactical Battle Record * 50, Sniper Chip * 4, Specialist Chip * 4, Sniper Dualchip * 4, Specialist Dualchip * 4

CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 90, Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 1, LMD * 200000, Strategic Battle Record * 40, Tactical Battle Record * 50, Skill Summary - 3 * 30, Skill Summary - 2 * 50, Chip Catalyst * 4, Furniture Part * 500
CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 37, Senior Operator Training Invitation Letter * 1
Players can select one 5* Operator below Elite 2 and directly promote them to Elite 2 Lv. 1. Resources already used on this Operator will NOT be recovered after promotion.
12 OPERATOR SAVAGE FREE TO CLAIM FOR LIMITED-TIME
DETAILS: After the event begins, 5* Operator Savage * 1 will be sent to players via in-game mail.
REQUIREMENT: All the players who have logged in and created a character before January 14, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7), including guest accounts.
Players who already have Operator Savage will obtain Savage's Token * 1 from this email, which can be used to improve the Potential of Savage.
DETAILS: After the event begins, Operator Voucher * 1 will be sent to players via in-game mail. Players can use this voucher to redeem one of the following 5* Operators:
EXPIRY DATE: 30 days after receiving the mail
REQUIREMENT: All players (this event is permanent)
14 NEW PERMANENT REWARD – SENIOR OPERATOR TRANSFER PERMIT
DETAILS: After the event begins, Senior Operator Transfer Permit * 1 will be sent to players via in-game mail. Players can use this permit to redeem one of the 5* Operators within range.
EXPIRY DATE: 30 days after receiving the mail
REQUIREMENT: All players (this event is permanent)
DETAILS: Reset all players' Originium first-time purchase bonus. After reset, players can get double Originium for the first-time purchase again.
